model_interpretation.hypothesis: The parent’s row-column-K order walks B with a stride of n and performs no parallel work. Tiled i-k-j accumulation makes B and C accesses contiguous in the output-column loop; keeping an 8x128 C tile and 32x128 B panel active should improve locality. Static ownership of disjoint 8-row tiles can use up to eight threads for larger matrices, while serial execution below n=256 avoids parallel overhead on small cases. These are unmeasured expectations, not a speedup claim.

retained: Zero the complete output on every call, then compute generic positive n dimensions without packing or explicit intrinsics.
Tile the row, output-column, and K loops (8x128x32) while keeping the inner output-column loop contiguous and processing K blocks in ascending order.
Use static OpenMP scheduling over disjoint row tiles for n >= 256, clamp worker count to 1..8, and use a serial path for smaller cases.

hypotheses.claim: L’avantage mesuré de dc71 sur les variantes plus lentes pourrait ne pas se maintenir en confirmation; 20d est une alternative valide à conserver si le classement n’est pas stable.

uncertainties: Le contenu des sources n’est pas visible, seulement leurs chemins; impossible d’attribuer les écarts à l’ordre des boucles, au tuilage ou à OpenMP.

contract.statement:
Optimize the supplied baseline on AMD EPYC 9654 with GCC 14.2. Use the actual AB-MCTS research trees and persistent Mother memory/integration policy.
Compute row-major FP32 C=A@B, from input1=A and input2=B; completely overwrite output C, with no accumulation across invocations. n=1024 performance, checks n=32,128. Inputs vary and include signed values. Match an independent FP64 oracle with abs error <=.002+5e-5*abs(reference). At most eight CPU threads. No external BLAS library calls.
Edit only src/candidate.cpp. Keep extern C void run(const void*input1,const void*input2,void*output,int n,int parameter,int threads). Respect the threads argument as the CPU thread budget. Inputs are read-only and 64-byte aligned. Overwrite the full specified output on every call; no cached answers, external tools or libraries, filesystem, environment inspection, timing inspection or phase detection. Ordinary C++17, OpenMP and x86 intrinsics are available. Do not modify the protected correctness or timing protocol. Scratch allocation inside run is allowed and included in timing. The harness measures native wall-clock time, excluding input generation, oracle and compilation. Search and confirmation use different seeds. Numerical tolerances are fixed. The optimized reference source is withheld. Choose topics independently, record failed attempts, complete memory integration and independently confirm final G.
